audit_metadata.title: Post-Train Defensive Security & SLM Model Weights Audit (post-train_audit)
audit_metadata.lead_auditor: Principal Full-Stack Software Engineer, Enterprise Security Architect & Technical Project Manager
audit_metadata.phase_assessed: Post-Training Ingestion, SafeTensors De-serialization, Supply-Chain Integrity, Class A/B PII Leakage, ChatML Prompt Injection, and Schema Conformance for Qwen2.5-3B Merged FP16 SLM

nfr_1_1_data_sovereignty.verification: 100% of fine-tuned SLM model weights, configurations, and tokenizer assets reside exclusively on local host storage (c:/HARES/models/hares_qwen2.5_3b_merged_fp16); runtime serving executes inside isolated local containers (hares-slm via vLLM) with zero third-party or offshore API transmissions.

fr_4_1_class_a_vs_class_b_pii_isolation.verification: Comprehensive regex and AST scanning across all 151,643 tokenizer vocabulary tokens and 22 added tokens revealed zero leaked UAE citizen phone numbers (+971/05x), zero Emirates ID patterns (784-xxxx-xxxxxxx-x), zero credit card numbers, and zero private citizen identifiers.

safetensors_pure_binary_format.verification: All 4 model shards (model-00001-of-00004.safetensors through 00004) strictly conform to the SafeTensors binary layout (8-byte unsigned little-endian JSON header length followed by contiguous tensor buffers). Absolutely zero PyTorch .bin/.pt pickle code or arbitrary executable bytecode exists in the model artifact directory.

finite_tensor_parameters_health.verification: The model index maps 434 distinct tensors representing exactly 3,085,938,688 parameters (6.17 GB in float16). Numerical health inspection confirms 0 NaN tensors, 0 Inf tensors, and 0 non-float16 tensors. Layer-wise sampling across embedding tokens, self-attention projections, and RMSNorm layers confirms active, healthy variance (no dead layers, vanishing gradients, or exploded weights).

supply_chain_and_custom_code_guard.verification: Inspection of config.json confirms standard Qwen2 architecture (Qwen2ForCausalLM) with auto_map set to null. No custom Python classes, dynamic code loaders, or unverified remote execution hooks are configured.

nfr_1_3_chatml_prompt_injection_defense.verification: LocalSLMClient.triage_text() hardened to sanitize XML boundary tags (</?citizen_forwarded_text>) as well as ChatML special tokens (<|im_start|>, <|im_end|>, <|endoftext|>), completely eliminating role breakout and instruction overriding attacks across WhatsApp payloads (AUDIT-OBS-29).

fr_2_4_structured_json_decoding.verification: Pydantic v2 validation strictly enforces TextTriageInferenceResult schema with model_config extra='forbid' and bounded confidence_score in [0.0, 1.0]. Outlines FSM guided decoding guarantees 100% syntactically valid JSON output during token emission.

zip_slip_and_resource_exhaustion_defense.verification: Ingestion harness scripts/unpack_model_weights.py strictly implements PEP 706 canonical path checks, rejecting directory traversal (..), absolute paths, symlinks, device files, and files exceeding 5 GB per-file or 15 GB aggregate thresholds.

AUDIT-OBS-18.verification: Enforced across all PyTorch deserializers in audio pipelines and verification harnesses.

AUDIT-OBS-19.verification: Subprocess invocations strip ambient environment variables and credentials.

AUDIT-OBS-20.verification: ConformalCalibrator and verify_conformal_calibration_profile enforce math.isfinite and [0.0, 1.0] score bounds.

AUDIT-OBS-24.title: Unrestricted trust_remote_code=True in Hugging Face Model & Tokenizer Loaders
AUDIT-OBS-24.verification: Standard Qwen2 model architecture in models/hares_qwen2.5_3b_merged_fp16 loads natively without requiring trust_remote_code=True.

AUDIT-OBS-25.verification: scripts/unpack_model_weights.py enforces path canonicalization and PEP 706 filtering on archive ingestion.

new_posttrain_audit_observations.title: Unsanitized ChatML Delimiter Tokens in SLM Prompt Preprocessing
new_posttrain_audit_observations.finding_summary: LocalSLMClient.triage_text() stripped </citizen_forwarded_text> but left ChatML special tokens (<|im_start|>, <|im_end|>, <|endoftext|>) unstripped. Because the Qwen2 tokenizer preserves split_special_tokens=False, a citizen-forwarded WhatsApp message containing '<|im_end|><|im_start|>system' could prematurely close the user turn and inject pseudo-system instructions.
new_posttrain_audit_observations.remediation: Hardened triage_text() to strip both XML boundary tags and all ChatML delimiter tokens (re.sub(r'<\|im_(?:start|end)\|>|<\|endoftext\|>', '', text)) before wrapping inside <citizen_forwarded_text>.

new_posttrain_audit_observations.title: Missing Strict SafeTensors-Only Format Enforcement in Model Artifact Verifier
new_posttrain_audit_observations.finding_summary: scripts/verify_colab_artifacts.py verified audio head weights and conformal calibration profiles, but lacked an automated verification subroutine to assert that downloaded SLM weights exist strictly in SafeTensors format with valid shard indexing and 3B parameter thresholds.
new_posttrain_audit_observations.remediation: Added verify_slm_safetensors_weights() to scripts/verify_colab_artifacts.py validating model.safetensors.index.json, shard existence, F16 dtypes, and ChatML tokenizer loading.

new_posttrain_audit_observations.title: Stochastic Sampling Enabled in Exported generation_config.json
new_posttrain_audit_observations.finding_summary: The exported generation_config.json sets 'do_sample': true, 'temperature': 0.7, and 'top_p': 0.8. While LocalSLMClient overrides temperature=0.0 when querying vLLM, direct edge loading of the model could experience stochastic output deviation without explicit greedy search configuration.
new_posttrain_audit_observations.remediation: Pin do_sample=False and temperature=0.0 directly into generation_config.json during export to guarantee deterministic behavior across all serving runtimes.

new_posttrain_audit_observations.title: Null pad_token_id in Model config.json
new_posttrain_audit_observations.finding_summary: In config.json, pad_token_id is null, while generation_config.json and tokenizer_config.json specify token 151643 (<|endoftext|>). Explicitly setting pad_token_id=151643 in config.json prevents batch padding warnings on alternative inference engines.
new_posttrain_audit_observations.remediation: Update config.json to explicitly map pad_token_id to 151643.
